changelog: - **MARKETING vertical starts on a sales funnel, seeded at org creation** (#2353, epic #2348). A new `MARKETING_FUNNEL` program template (`src/lib/programTemplates.ts`) — a seven-stage lead-to-deal pipeline (New lead → Contacted → Qualified → Proposal → Negotiation → Won/Lost) with its own EN/TR/DE labels, its own follow-up cadence and SLAs, and its own keys (`LEAD_*`, `DEAL_*`, never a canonical internship key) — is provisioned into a new MARKETING organization's `PipelineStage` rows at creation. `defaultTemplateForVertical()` maps a vertical to its starting template; `provisionStagePreset()` applies it, and an INTERNSHIP org maps to nothing so it starts on the canonical built-ins with no rows written, exactly as before verticals existed. Provisioning runs server-side at creation, deliberately bypassing the stage editor's FREE-plan gate (seeding a tenant is a super-admin act, not a tenant self-service edit). The stage write itself is now one shared `replaceStages()` used by both org provisioning and the admin stage editor, so the two can never drift in how a row is shaped. A no-op for today's product; a MARKETING e2e asserts the funnel lands and an INTERNSHIP e2e asserts nothing is written.
